translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: He gallassi laappun mac'c'a asatuu itti attumawaa oyk'k'iide, «Nuuni nu k'umaa maana; nu mayuwaa mayyana; ne suntsan s'eesetana mala ootsaadde nu kawushshaa nuuppe k'aaraarikkii» yaagiide woosana.
He gallassi Med'inaa Godaa mitsaa tashii lo"ananne bonchchettana; Israa'eeliyaa asaappe atteedawanttoo he gadiyaa katsay c'eek'k'onne bonchchuwaa gidanawaa.
S'iyoonen attiyaawanttu, Yerusaalamen gam"iyaawanttu, Yerusaalamen pas'a de'iyaawanttunna s'aafettiyaawanttu, «Unttunttu geeshshatuwaa» geetettana.
Goday S'iyoone mac'c'a asatuwaa k'itaa meec'c'ana; pirddaa Ayaanaaninne s'uuggiyaa Ayaanan suutsaa gussiyaa bayzzuwaa Yerusaalameppe I geeshshana.
Med'inaa Goday S'iyoone Deriyaa ubbaa bollanne yan shiik'iyaawanttu bolla gallassi shaariyaanne c'uwaa, k'amma ees's'iyaa tamaa poo'uwaa med'd'ana; bonchchuu ubbaa bolla kammiyaawaa gidanawaa.
I gallassaa aawaa suuluwaappe ashshiyaa kuwaanne gotiyaappenne iraappe bak'ati attiyaasaa gidanawaa.
